resolved_config.statistics: Paired complete-case participant bootstrap within panel and endpoint. Missing omitted subjects are excluded before resampling in both models, with counts/IDs reported. Equal average of three panel differences within network, independent panel resampling; no network pooling. Lower95>=-.02 supports practical noninferiority; upper95<-.02 supports material inferiority; otherwise unresolved. CE is reported separately, no new CE tolerance.
